stun.scope: Explicit native AddProfToDummy/RemoveSpecificProficiency fixture. No enemy attack, natural duration, turn progression or online claim. Guardian state is queried only, never set by this helper.

petrifyAttempt.scope: Explicit native AddProfToDummy/RemoveSpecificProficiency fixture. No enemy attack, natural duration, turn progression or online claim. Guardian state is queried only, never set by this helper.

nativeFindings.stun: CharacterDummy.Stunned includes Stunned and Dazed. AddProfToDummy applies the native effect; its framework postfix expires ineligible Guard. RemoveSpecificProficiency removes the record and calls End.
nativeFindings.petrify: ProficiencyPetrify.AddToDummy requires m_DamageInfo.m_NewHealth > 0 before adding its record, then starts a visual freeze coroutine. End creates a replacement avatar. Direct synchronous add/remove without surviving hit context does not test it.

sourceFollowup: Removed Petrify from this synchronous helper; unsupported categories now reject before mutation. Stun application/removal remains unchanged.
limits: Explicit native proficiency fixture; does not establish an enemy stun hit or natural timed recovery.
Ready rescue availability is preserved; no spent-charge incapacity assertion.
Petrification remains unverified live. Its failed attempt did not enter Petrified state and does not establish a production defect.
